title: Nvidia joins VAST Data's Series F at a $30B valuation

sources.quote: The latest round was led by Drive Capital, with Access Industries acting as co-lead, and included participation from existing investors including Fidelity Management & Research Company, NEA, and NVIDIA, alongside new investors.

explain: Nvidia put more money into VAST Data, a maker of AI data storage software, in a roughly $1 billion round (new shares plus shares sold by existing holders) that valued VAST at $30 billion. Nvidia's own share of the round was not disclosed.
